long_description:
A free afternoon of movement, sound bath, healthy food, mini treatments, networking, and connection with local women-owned businesses.

About this Event

The EmpowerHER Experience is an in-person event for the general public, focused on women’s health, happiness, well-being, and connection.

Join us for an exclusive afternoon with women-owned businesses and wellness professionals dedicated to educating, empowering, and inspiring women to thrive. Take time to move your body, nourish your mind and body, explore new ways to care for yourself, and connect with women who support healthier, happier lives.

What Awaits You

Stretch & Move: Enjoy gentle, refreshing movement to reconnect with your body.
Relax & Restore: Experience the calming benefits of a guided sound bath.
Nourish & Connect: Enjoy delicious, healthy food while mingling with like-minded women.
Meet the Experts: Discover women-owned businesses offering wellness, beauty, movement, recovery, networking, practical help, and self-care services.
Treat Yourself: Enjoy complimentary mini treatments and wellness experiences from participating professionals.
Win Something Wonderful: Enter raffles for exciting prizes, services, and memberships.

Also check out other in San Ramon, Health & Wellness events in San Ramon.
